owner_pasted_text_verbatim:
I read the sample. My recommendation is: keep identifying which thing occupies each role, improve the pointing rules, and choose option B for the next usefulness test
What actually happened
Both teams labeled 428 passages. Only Mind passed every requirement. The other eight failed this particular labeling test, for different reasons
Cause and Effect mostly had a pointing problem. For example:

* One team selected “Its lanolin scent”
* The other selected “Its lanolin scent filled the small shop”
* Both connected it to the same memory of a grandfather’s overcoat

They largely agreed about the meaning but selected different amounts of text. Of 27 Cause misses, 22 had both teams recognizing the role but differing in the selected wording or related thing
Vibration and Rhythm had a different problem. Often one team said the role was present and the other didn’t. A shorter quotation rule won’t resolve that
I would improve Claude’s proposed fix
Use a short, consistent identifying label PLUS the full supporting quote. Don’t reduce everything to one word: “girl” loses the meaning of a remembered childhood scene, and “pallets” loses the repeated activity of pallets moving down a conveyor
Also count extra and missing roles separately. The present scoring can count a passage as agreement when one matching pair exists, even if one team adds other unmatched roles
What A, B and C mean
A: Build the new internal reader first, then test whether its readings help B
B: First give B carefully checked role descriptions from the labeling teams. Compare against ordinary help and no help. This tells us whether that information is useful before investing in the reader
C: Repeat the old design with its scorer fixed
I recommend B. It tests the practical premise early. A later test must still show that the internal reader can supply equally useful descriptions. C is less informative because the old guidance didn’t identify the task’s specific role relationships
Your two definition decisions remain important:

1. Does recognizing a familiar sign count as Cause → Effect when it brings another idea to mind?
2. Does an idea reached through reasoning also count as Effect?

Those are your framework’s meanings to settle. The pointing method can be repaired without changing them
